checks.title: App Transport Security disabled (NSAllowsArbitraryLoads)
checks.expected_secure_behavior: ATS stays enabled; any exception is narrowly scoped to a named domain.
checks.remediation: Remove NSAllowsArbitraryLoads or set it to false, serve endpoints over TLS 1.2+, and use NSExceptionDomains only for documented legacy hosts.

owasp: OWASP Mobile Top 10 2024: M5 Insecure Communication

checks.title: get-task-allow entitlement enabled
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Distribution builds do not carry get-task-allow=true.
checks.remediation: Ensure release/distribution provisioning profiles and entitlements set get-task-allow to false (it is only injected for development signing).

owasp: OWASP Mobile Top 10 2024: M7 Insufficient Binary Protections

checks.title: Insecure Keychain accessibility or secrets in UserDefaults
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Secrets are stored in the Keychain with WhenUnlocked/AfterFirstUnlock ThisDeviceOnly accessibility, never in UserDefaults.
checks.remediation: Replace kSecAttrAccessibleAlways* with kSecAttrAccessibleWhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly (or AfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly when background access is required) and move tokens and passwords out of UserDefaults into the Keychain.

owasp: OWASP Mobile Top 10 2024: M9 Insecure Data Storage

checks.title: Deprecated UIWebView or WKWebView file-URL access preferences
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Only WKWebView is used and file-URL access preferences stay at their secure defaults.
checks.remediation: Migrate UIWebView to WKWebView, remove allowFileAccessFromFileURLs / allowUniversalAccessFromFileURLs overrides and load local content with loadFileURL(_:allowingReadAccessTo:) scoped to one directory.

owasp: OWASP Mobile Top 10 2024: M4 Insufficient Input/Output Validation

checks.title: URL scheme and universal link hijack validation
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Sensitive flows use verified universal links and validate all URL scheme input and callers.
checks.remediation: Prefer universal links with a correct apple-app-site-association, validate and sanitise every URL parameter, and never pass tokens via custom URL schemes. Verify on an authorized test device.

checks.title: Runtime binary protections review (jailbreak detection, anti-tamper)
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Binary protections match the app's risk profile and are documented, with the limits of client-side detection understood.
checks.remediation: Review jailbreak, debugger and integrity detection against the app's threat model; treat them as defence in depth and keep sensitive decisions server-side.
